item.title: Sail Selina NY Coming to Shelter Island
item.description: The 1926 Crosby catboat Selina II is coming home to the North Fork. After 25 years sailing out of St. Michaels, Maryland, the 41-foot wooden vessel will return this spring to the East End waters where she was built, just in time for her 100th anniversary in 2026.
